description: This is Japan's national open register of medical facilities, taken from the Medical Information Net (Navii), which is built from the details that hospitals, clinics, dental clinics, maternity homes and pharmacies report. It is published by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW). The facility tables give each facility's identifier, official, short and English names, class, prefecture and municipality codes, address, latitude and longitude, website and regular closing days; companion tables give the departments and consultation hours of hospitals, clinics and dental clinics. The June 2026 hospital table lists about 7,700 hospitals. The files are free and available to download as zipped CSV under the Public Data License 1.0, with snapshots in June and December since August 2024. Caveats: only part of the information shown in Navii is released as open data, facilities report their own details, and codes need the definition document. Simulation uses: mapping hospitals and clinics against earthquake, tsunami and flood hazards, modelling travel-time access to care, and checking which facilities are open at a given hour after a disaster. Related records: the ambulance difficult transport cases (data-meshscope-ems-japan-difficult-transport-cases) cover emergency transport in Japan, and the Brazilian CNES register (data-cnes-brazil-health-establishments-api) and the US CMS provider data (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) are comparable registers.
